text: Second Quarter Financial Highlights • Adobe achieved record quarterly revenue of $1.40 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 20 percent.

• Digital Media segment revenue grew by 26 percent year-over-year to a record $943 million, with Creative revenue growing 37 percent year-over-year to a record $755 million.
• Adobe Marketing Cloud achieved record revenue of $385 million that represents year-over-year growth of 18 percent.
• Cash flow from operations was $489 million, and deferred revenue grew to $1.68 billion.

“Our record revenue reflects our market leadership and the exploding demand for digital experience solutions.” “Record revenue with strong profit and cash flow highlight our second quarter results,” said Mark Garrett, Adobe executive vice president and chief financial officer.
